p: If it's been a while since you last bowled, here's a refresher on how the scoring works. Every game has ten frames, and you get two goes at the pins in each. A strike, all ten down on your first ball, scores ten plus your next two balls. A spare, clearing the rest on your second, scores ten plus your next ball. Get three strikes in a row and you've bagged a turkey; a full game of strikes is a perfect 300.

Some simple advice for beginners: pick a ball that you can swing smoothly, aim at the arrows on the lane rather than the pins, and follow through straight. Don't step over the foul line, or the shot doesn't count.

If you're visiting with family or making a weekend of it, there's lots more to do in and around MK. Gulliver's Land is a theme park aimed at younger children, and Woburn Safari Park is a short drive away over the Bedfordshire border. The town also has plenty of green space, with the redways, a network of shared paths for walkers and cyclists, connecting much of the town and its parks.

With its grid roads, Milton Keynes is easy to get around by car, and Milton Keynes Central station has fast links to London and the Midlands. For big groups, book well in advance and arrive early so the first frame starts on time.
